title: Terminal
description: A command and its output: streams and follows the end (unless people scroll up), shows a spinner while running and the exit code when done, with a copy button.
when: Agents and jobs that run shell commands, builds, deploy logs.

instead.need: A tool call with JSON in / out

a11y: The log is focusable for keyboard scrolling and not a live region (streamed lines are not read aloud); status is text (exit code).
